saints.name: St. Monica
saints.title: Widow
saints.shortBlurb: The mother of St. Augustine, whose tears and prayers over many years won her son to Christ…
biography: Born in North Africa, Monica married a pagan husband whom she won by patience, and bore Augustine, for whose conversion she prayed and wept for years as he wandered into error. She followed him to Italy, where she rejoiced to see him received into the Church by St. Ambrose.
Shortly after, at Ostia, mother and son shared a famous vision of heavenly things; there she died, content, asking only to be remembered at the altar. She is the model of Christian mothers.
saints.knownFor: Her persevering prayer for her son's conversion.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 4 May
